title: Mommy rates your study habits (Vex, Scribe; rating format)

beats.say: Mommy's rating your study habits. Don't lie to me.
Forty-seven tabs open... and not one of them is your homework? Two out of ten.
Third energy drink at midnight? Zero. Your heart is begging, baby.
Highlighting the whole page isn't studying. It's coloring. Minus one.
Studying in bed? Hmm... six. Mommy does it too.
But this bio worksheet? Ten out of ten. Watch.
Scribe learned your handwriting from one practice sheet. Then I make it a little messy, so it looks like you rushed it. Punnett square and all.
Three to one, your professor buys it.
Final score? Ten out of ten. Now come here, baby.
